questions.question: What is the inclusion-exclusion formula for two events $A$ and $B$?
questions.explanation: Inclusion-exclusion: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$, subtracting the double-counted overlap.
questions.source_support: The definition states $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$.

questions.source_support: The interpretation says inclusion-exclusion corrects double counting.
